02_landing.text: This is THRIVE, the Teacher Hub for Resources,.
It is built for teachers working in India's government and low-fee schools,.
Where one teacher often handles several grade groups at once.
THRIVE is built around that reality.

03_home.text: When a teacher signs in, everything needed for the day sits on one calm page.
Saved plans, training progress, and the latest updates from the education department,.
Each linked back to an official source.

04_compiler.text: The heart of THRIVE is the Multi-Grade Classroom Compiler.
A teacher says which grades are in the room,.
For how long, and what the children should learn.
A shared opening, a dedicated teacher-led turn for each grade,.
Independent work for the groups who are waiting, and the minutes always add up exactly.
And if the plan is not possible in the time available,.
THRIVE says so, and explains why, instead of hiding it.

05_guided.text: When a teacher is not sure where to start,.
Guided setup asks a few simple questions and prepares the plan.
Any part of it can be changed, and every section can be regenerated on its own,.
So a teacher's own edits are never lost.

06_assistant.text: Then there is the Teaching Assistant.
A teacher can ask, in English or in Hindi,.
How to explain evaporation using nothing but chalk and a blackboard.
The answer is built from THRIVE's curriculum corpus,.
And every reply shows its sources, so it can be checked.
When the corpus does not cover something, THRIVE says so, rather than making it up.

07_training.text: The Training Centre holds short practice modules written by THRIVE.
And each module links to verified professional development from DIKSHA and NISHTHA.
It is a learning record, not an official certificate.

08_updates.text: Verified Education Updates collects policy news and official resources,.
Each with its source, with search and bookmarks.
No unverified circulars, and no invented announcements.

09_community.text: And the Teacher Community lets teachers share what actually works in the classroom,.
With replies, helpful votes, and moderation.
